title: 4 Classes, Many Paths
description:
“A good reason to buy this game, it that you like Magic.”

Enter an Awesome Open World, Single-Player RPG focused on Crafting and Creativity.

A world full of Ancient Secrets; With dragons, demons, and deep dungeons waiting for you.

Inspired by classic RPGs like Skyrim, Oblivion, and Morrowind.

Choose your path:

• Fighter – Strong Warrior with heavy attacks and defense.

• Ranger – Skilled Hunter with bows, and survival abilities.

• Rogue – Shadow Killers using stealth and Back Stab.

• Wizard – Spell Caster, Using powerful magic and forbidden knowledge.

Create your own character with many skills and perks.

Mix different skills and perks to create your own character type;

From a giant barbarian warrior to a powerful elemental battle-mage.

Buy it, here and now; Start on your path to Power.

-

I have spend a lot of time to reduce choice paralysis, making it easy to play this game.

No choice overload, and very little Decision Fatigue, by limiting the choice you are forced to make.

 

Create your own unique character, with his own unique skills; 1 million different ways to player.

Craft your own Unique Sword; You can select over 1 billion combinations.

Combine alchemy to create a million different potions.

  

I love playing open-world RPGs like Skyrim, Oblivion, and Morrowind, as well as exploring Tolkien’s 'Lord of the Rings' universe. So, I’ve taken the parts I enjoy most from them: the wild magic and alchemy from Morrowind, the bright colors of Oblivion, and Skyrim’s weapon improvements.

So if you like skyrim, or if you like morrowind, then try this game.

I have added MineCraft like building, so now you can build your own home, the way you like it.
